body:
Soap, gloves, and two water jugs, paid cash. On the back: “Trial crew used the sink at dawn. My eyes burned before the road was shut.”

I saved it from the bag of rubbish because there was a name on the reverse. The name was not on the list they posted.

It could be a mistake in the copying. The things stacked beside the page were real enough, and still waiting to be moved.
title: Soap bought after the field run
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.
